ada.text: Good morning, everyone! My errand was out to the orchard, where I checked on the blossom for my bees; they'll be busy there soon. The air was crisp, the hives were humming, and I walked back with a very happy heart. Nothing sweeter than a morning with the bees.

bo.text: I'd planned a quiet morning of music on the green. Then my plans changed three times before breakfast: the pond hall, then the orchard, then not the orchard. I'm a shy sort, so I took it as a hint to stop and listen. It turns out the best song of the day was the one I hadn't planned.
